source: 영덕중2 L6 배부물 14·15쪽 «Lesson 6 단어» (= 영덕중2 L6 Wordlist.pdf 1·2쪽, 동일 파일)
source_note: Z: 스캔. 배부물 15쪽짜리의 끝 두 쪽과 Wordlist 2쪽이 sha256 동일 — 원천은 하나다.
why_best: 가진 어휘 원천 중 유일하게 교과서 쪽수·한글뜻·영영풀이·예문·예문해석을 한 줄에 다 갖췄다. 자습서에서 뽑은 것보다 낫다.

words.def_en: a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine
words.example_en: I read an interesting article about space travel.
words.example_ko: 나는 우주여행에 관한 흥미로운 기사를 하나 읽었다.

words.def_en: to put something into a hole in the ground and cover it
words.example_en: Tommy and I buried the time capsule under the tree.
words.example_ko: Tommy와 나는 나무 아래에 타임캡슐을 묻었다.

words.def_en: a place where people put dead bodies in the ground
words.example_en: There is an old cemetery near my house.
words.example_ko: 내 집 근처에 오래된 묘지가 있다.

words.def_en: to keep doing something without stopping
words.example_en: They continued to play soccer in the rain.
words.example_ko: 그들은 빗속에서도 축구를 계속했다.

words.def_en: a South Asian dish of meat, vegetables, etc., cooked in a hot spicy sauce
words.example_en: I love eating curry with rice.
words.example_ko: 나는 밥과 함께 카레를 먹는 것을 좋아한다.

words.def_en: in or from a country that is not your own
words.example_en: I want to work in a foreign country in the future.
words.example_ko: 나는 미래에 외국에서 일하고 싶다.

words.def_en: a person who comes from another country
words.example_en: Jisu spoke to the foreigner in English.
words.example_ko: 지수는 그 외국인에게 영어로 말했다.

words.def_en: to come together in a group in one place
words.example_en: We will gather at the park for running.
words.example_ko: 우리는 달리기를 하러 공원에 모일 것이다.

words.def_en: the group of people who officially control a country
words.example_en: The government decided to build a new hospital.
words.example_ko: 정부는 새로운 병원을 짓기로 결정했다.

words.def_en: to go somewhere where you hope you will not be seen or found
words.example_en: The children were hiding under the bed.
words.example_ko: 그 아이들은 침대 아래에 숨어 있었다.

words.def_en: important in history
words.example_en: Rome is famous for its historic buildings.
words.example_ko: 로마는 역사적인 건물들로 유명하다.

words.def_en: freedom from political control by other countries
words.example_en: Students played an important role in the independence movement.
words.example_ko: 학생들은 독립운동에서 중요한 역할을 했다.

words.def_en: not governed or ruled by another country
words.example_en: India became an independent country in 1947.
words.example_ko: 인도는 1947년에 독립적인 나라가 되었다.

words.def_en: a written or spoken request for asking someone to come to an event
words.example_en: He gave me an invitation to the party.
words.example_ko: 그는 나에게 파티 초대장을 줬다.

words.def_en: the study and treatment of diseases and injuries
words.example_en: She decided to study medicine to become a doctor.
words.example_ko: 그녀는 의사가 되기 위해 의학을 공부하기로 결심했다.

words.def_en: an action that a group of people take to change something in society
words.example_en: Let's join the environmental movement to protect the Earth.
words.example_ko: 지구를 보호하기 위해 환경 운동에 참여하자.

words.def_en: a long story about imaginary characters and events
words.example_en: She enjoys reading historical novels in her free time.
words.example_ko: 그녀는 여가 시간에 역사 소설을 읽는 것을 즐긴다.

words.def_en: to suggest that someone or something would be good
words.example_en: Which dish do you recommend for lunch?
words.example_ko: 점심으로 어떤 요리를 추천하시나요?

words.def_en: to collect information about or for something
words.example_en: They researched many restaurants before they ate out.
words.example_ko: 그들은 외식하기 전에 많은 레스토랑을 조사했다.

words.def_en: caring more about other people's needs and interests than about your own
words.example_en: She is a selfless person who always helps others.
words.example_ko: 그녀는 항상 다른 사람을 돕는 이타적인 사람이다.

words.def_en: an extra force used when pronouncing a particular word or syllable
words.example_en: The teacher explained the importance of stress in speaking clearly.
words.example_ko: 선생님은 명확하게 말하는 데 있어 강세의 중요성을 설명했다.

words.def_en: not able to be believed because it is unlikely
words.example_en: We had an unbelievable time in London.
words.example_ko: 우리는 런던에서 믿기 어려울 정도로 멋진 시간을 보냈다.

words.def_en: while being watched carefully by somebody
words.example_en: The soccer players trained under the watchful eye of their coach.
words.example_ko: 축구 선수들은 코치의 감시 아래에서 훈련을 했다.

words.def_en: to do a job without being paid for it / a person who does a job without being paid for it
words.example_en: He plans to volunteer at the hospital next summer. / The volunteers worked together to clean up the beach.
words.example_ko: 그는 내년 여름에 병원에서 자원봉사를 할 계획이다. / 자원봉사자들은 해변을 청소하기 위해 함께 일했다.
